title: Specify who may access LHR data and how
requirements:
- Include authorised representatives and supported decision-making in access and control
- Specify justification, scope, duration and after-the-fact review of emergency access
- Define purpose-specific minimum datasets for claims and financing rather than broad clinical access
- Add a cross-cutting access and delegation profile for person-facing tools
- Require assisted, non-digital and accessible channels, and understandable access history
- Allow governed individual contributions to the record
